findings.headline: Replace tsup-preset-solid, which compiles JSX for Solid 1.
findings.why: tsup-preset-solid runs babel-preset-solid 1.x, whose output imports solid-js/web and the Solid 1 runtime helpers, which Solid 2.0.3 doesn't have. No release of it targets Solid 2.
findings.guidance: Build with @solidjs/vite-plugin (Vite library mode for a library), or keep this bundler and run @solidjs/babel-plugin@2.0.2 through its Babel hook with moduleName "@solidjs/web". Stop and ask before changing a published library's build output.
